title: Conditional orbit-EGF insertion into the fixed-beta Duhamel remainder
question: Can the registered four-context factorial history envelope be inserted into the EXP-001062 two-sided remainder without hiding the actual-Q3 history hypothesis?

conditional_inputs.central_context: All four A^(a) D A^(-b) contexts are bounded by the registered one-step rate B on a common core, uniformly in volume, source and orientation.
conditional_inputs.factorial_history: The two-orientation degree-six history has nonnegative coefficients bounded by eta^n with eta=orientations*degree*spatial_base*B*T.
conditional_inputs.geometric_majorant: For 0<=eta<1, the conditional history sum is bounded by the geometric envelope G=1/(1-eta).
conditional_inputs.remainder_input: EXP-001062 supplies the finite-member t^2 K/2 remainder once K is replaced by the orbit envelope K_initial*G.
conditional_inputs.not_supplied: EXP-001045 supplies only one-step mixed inputs; neither the four contexts nor the factorial recurrence is an actual Q3 theorem.

composition.rate: B is recomputed from the actual onsite, three Q3 edge and six spatial-bond source polynomials at S=1/4.
composition.modular: With a separate modular multiplier m, ||mR_+-mR_-||_(beta,#)<=m*T^2*K_initial/(1-eta).

scope.not_closed: The conditional composition does not prove the actual Q3 four-context estimate or factorial recurrence, so no volume-uniform direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure follows.

adversarial_review.check: B is recomputed from the registered weighted mixed graph fixture and is not pasted into the script.
The central-context bound remains an explicit conditional input; the one-step rate is not promoted to an operator theorem.
The geometric sum assumes a nonnegative history coefficient bound; actual Q3 cancellations and domains remain open.
eta<1 is checked from the declared time horizon; no all-time statement is inferred.
Both orientations are retained in the remainder triangle estimate and no parity equality is assumed.
The modular multiplier is a separate conditional input from EXP-001062; Hamiltonian and modular domains are not identified.
R245 checks exact rational eta, denominator and remainder arithmetic; it does not formalize unbounded Q3 history convergence.
No thermodynamic OS identification, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or heat_root_incidence/A1/R-192 owner follows.

qft_interface.closed: A conditional scalar composition: the registered central-context/factorial envelope supplies an explicit small-time orbit bound that can be inserted into the two-sided fixed-beta Duhamel remainder.
qft_interface.open: The actual Q3 four-context and factorial history theorems, volume-uniform direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, common alpha, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
